# Ctrl-C stops the command and leaves the run open with its claim held. The next beehave run continues the same run.
! exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star &
waitfile started
kill -INT
wait

exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\trunning\tnow '
! grep '^release' events.log

exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\tgate pass at [0-9a-f]+\treview 2/24\t'
! stdout 'item-7-r2'

grep -count=1 '^plan ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^implement ' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- hang --
implement
-- verdicts --
approve
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
release 7
